temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth denies being upset with him. She says she is dealing with personal stuff and apologizes if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth might be upset with him, possibly due to an unknown misunderstanding or mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Elizabeth's explanation disconfirms that she is angry at him. He updates that her curtness is due to personal stress, not something he did.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and offer support if she wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts his offer of a coffee break and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is dealing with personal stress and is not upset with him; she may appreciate support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Her acceptance indicates she is open to his support and to spending time with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is willing to let him support her, at least through a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To provide support and listen during the coffee break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth shares more about her severe stress. When Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under severe personal stress and might benefit from professional help; Keith is concerned about suggesting it without offending her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Elizabeth does not reject the idea outright, but she is hesitant and uncertain about seeking help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could benefit Elizabeth, but she is hesitant and needs to decide at her own pace.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support her without pushing and to respect her hesitation.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after the professional-help suggestion. Keith apologizes for possibly overstepping, and Elizabeth says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is hesitant about professional help, but Keith hopes his suggestion was received without offense.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: He initially interprets her withdrawal as embarrassment or overstepping, but her reassurance disconfirms that she felt overstepped; she is still processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not overstep. Elizabeth appreciates his concern, but the issue remains heavy for her.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially regretful and worried, then relieved but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her of his support and avoid pressuring her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative. She thanks him, says his support means a lot, and says she feels better knowing she has his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is still processing a lot; Keith hopes to remain supportive without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Her openness and thanks confirm that she values his support and feels more comfortable with him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better; their supportive relationship is on firmer ground.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and be available for future chats or breaks.
